build_bpe_tokenizer: build a BPE tokenizer using bpe_factory with opt and shared parameters for ParlAI tokenization
encode_text_with_bpe: encode text into BPE tokens using the BPEHelper encode method with special token handling
decode_bpe_tokens: decode a list of BPE tokens back into text using the BPEHelper decode method
finalize_subword_bpe_codecs: finalize subword BPE codecs by calling finalize with token frequencies and num_symbols parameters
sync_bpe_with_dict: sync the BPE helper dictionary with a DictionaryAgent using the sync_with_dict method
